ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers and beneficial shareholders against the OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated sanctions list and Samoa domestic sanctions/FIU watchlists; PEP status verification (including PRC political exposure) at onboarding and on an ongoing risk-based basis; enhanced due diligence includes source-of-funds verification for settlement flows from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, consistent with the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies and International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registered legal name must be in Latin script and end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Corporation' or 'Corp'; all-Chinese articles of association are permissible as the controlling internal text provided a certified English translation is filed; a Chinese-language trade name may appear in the articles as a secondary style but not as the registered name; no statutory transliteration of the secondary Chinese name is required.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Trust, Trustee, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Brokerage, Financial Services, Funds, Capital (prior consent of the Central Bank of Samoa and/or the Samoa International Finance Authority required)
Building Society, Co-operative, Chamber of Commerce, University, College, Institute (prior ministerial consent required)
Government, Crown, Royal, State, National, Ministry, Authority, Samoa (or Samoan) as leading token where a false connection to the Government of Samoa or a public body is implied
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A written reconsideration request may be lodged with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice; if the Registrar confirms the rejection, the applicant may petition the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days of the confirmation; in practice filing a new name is faster (2–3 business days) than an appeal (4–6 weeks).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only as a licensed registered agent office in Samoa; a standalone virtual office without a licensed registered agent is not accepted, and no physical dedicated premises or employees in Samoa are required for the ISIC 9000 digital webtoon operation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; quantified risk of unannounced on-site inspection at approximately ≤5% per annum, with heightened probability only upon FIU suspicion, sanctions-hit, or Apple/Google merchant compliance complaints.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), ss. 5-17 (incorporation procedure), s. 9 (Memorandum and Articles of Association), s. 11 (Certificate of Incorporation), s. 55 (registered office and resident agent), s. 92 (annual government fee)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; no escrow account or deposit mandate under the International Companies Act 1987; share capital may be in any currency and issued at no par value
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that: (1) the first issue of shares as set out in the subscription statement is approved and allotted to the initial subscriber; (2) the registered office at the office of the licensed registered agent in Samoa is adopted as the statutory registered office; (3) the following officers are appointed: Director, Chief Operating Officer for Digital Syndication, and Corporate Secretary; (4) the company shall carry on solely offshore webtoon publishing and syndication consistent with the International Companies Act 1987; (5) the chairman is authorized to execute and deliver all ancillary documents. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application to SIFA via its central filing counter or licensed registered agent. The chosen name must not contain restricted words such as 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance', 'reinsurance', or otherwise be misleading if the corresponding regulated license is not held. The reservation is valid for 90 days and may be renewed once.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form in SIFA prescribed format
Proposed corporate name and two alternative names
Identity details of the initial shareholder(s)
Contact information of the applicant or operating service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the applicant may file a written response within 21 days of notice, or submit a revised name; if rejected on reserved words grounds, a new name reservation with a distinct corporate identifier may be filed without loss of prior priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Samoan registered agent and offshore corporate service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a SIFA-licensed registered agent to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English. The instrument must state the company name, registered agent address, share capital structure, permitted objects, and indemnity provisions. The initial subscriber executes the document before a witness, and the registered agent certifies compliance with the International Companies Act 1987.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of initial subscriber to become a shareholder
Certificate of name reservation issued by SIFA
Identification and proof of address of the subscriber and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any notarial or witnessing defect may be cured by re-execution of the affected page or by execution of a deed of rectification before a notary public; the agent will re-certify the corrected instrument.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing for Incorporation with the Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association together with the statutory application for incorporation form and the declaration by the registered agent. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 200. The application may be lodged electronically through the registered agent portal or in person at SIFA's registry. Incorporation takes effect upon entry of the company's name on the International Companies Register.
required_dossiers: Application for incorporation in prescribed Form
Original signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of registered agent to act
Payment receipt for the USD 200 government filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a requisition for further information, the registered agent shall within 21 days file a written explanation, amended filings, or evidence of consent; if the application is rejected, the full file may be re-submitted after corrections without losing the original incorporation date if processed within the same fee period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect the Certificate of Incorporation from SIFA or receive the electronic copy through the registered agent. Verify the certificate details against the submitted constitutional documents, including company number, date of incorporation, and registered agent. The company exists as a separate legal person as of the certificate date.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by SIFA
Registered person's office filing receipt
Mandatory statutory records set-up confirmation from registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should the certificate contain typographical or factual errors, request an administrative rectification notice from SIFA under the registered person's status correction process; a re-issued certificate is normally provided within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Registered Office and Resident Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Ensure the registered office is located at the principal office of the licensed resident agent in Apia, Samoa. The resident agent maintains the statutory registers and accepts service of process. The agent files the consent to act and the registered office address notification with SIFA. This is a standing obligation throughout the life of the company.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as resident agent
Registered office address confirmation letter
Agent's declaration of compliance with Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism obligations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent's consent is not acknowledged by SIFA, the company may engage a substitute SIFA-licensed agent and file a fresh consent; the company may be struck off if no agent is registered, so prompt substitution is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and the company secretary of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first meeting of the board or adopt the written first board resolution. Issue share certificates to the initial subscriber, open the register of directors, shareholders, and charges, and adopt a minute book. File the annual government fee with SIFA upon each anniversary. The company may contract with Apple and Google for in-app payment rails after obtaining its standard online account registrations.
required_dossiers: First board resolution (original signed)
Share certificates issued to shareholders
Register of directors and shareholders
Statutory minute book
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate records are challenged or lost, the board may adopt restated resolutions and issue replacement share certificates with indemnity declarations, subject to the consent of the registered agent and any affected shareholder.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies; for general commercial activities, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) would be relevant, but no industrial license is applicable to offshore digital webtoon publishing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required – no statutory industrial or physical operating permit applies to digital webtoon syndication; the only recurring authorization is the annual International Company government fee payable to SIFA

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) – Environmental Assessment Division
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no EIA registration or environmental impact report required because the operation is purely digital and generates no physical construction, emission source, or waste stream
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable – zero industrial wastewater discharge, zero VOC or particulate emissions, and zero hazardous waste generation; if a future leased office is established, general municipal sanitation and electronic waste disposal rules would apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to a remote, facility-free digital publishing model; the statutory registered office maintained by the licensed agent does not require fire safety certification. If a local office is subsequently opened, fire clearance from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) and occupational safety registration under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2010 would be required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Government of Samoa — online eServices portal at www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident-owned Samoa International Company (IC) is first incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 through a licensed registered agent (TCSP). The agent files Form MfR-TIN-01 with the Ministry for Revenue together with the Certificate of Incorporation, the IC charter, proof of the registered agent relationship, and identification evidence of the ultimate beneficial owner; a TIN is issued within 5–10 business days via the eServices portal. For an IC wholly engaged in international business with no Samoan-source income and no transactions with Samoa residents, no active income tax registration arises; VAGST registration is required only where the IC makes taxable supplies in Samoa, or is voluntarily registered to claim input credits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa law provides no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election. Under the International Companies Act 1987, the IC automatically enjoys exemption from Samoan income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and estate duty on international business, subject to an annual renewal fee. The IC may elect (by special resolution filed with the Samoa Companies Office) to re-domicile or convert to an ordinary resident company under the Companies Act 2006, thereby entering the territorial taxation regime of the Income Tax Act 2012; the IC may also elect to register for VAGST under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2018 if it makes taxable supplies in Samoa.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WS$100,000 (WST 100,000) annual taxable turnover for taxable supplies made in Samoa; mandatory registration at or above threshold, voluntary registration below threshold. Non-resident suppliers of imported digital services to Samoan consumers must separately register once annual digital turnover exceeds WS$30,000 under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2018, as amended.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or government digital stamping applies in Samoa. Registered businesses must issue sequentially numbered tax invoices containing prescribed supplier/customer details and the VAGST amount, file monthly or two-monthly VAGST returns, and pay via the MfR eServices portal; supporting electronic records must be retained for at least 5 years. MfR conducts risk-based automated cross-matching of declared export turnover against platform settlement and banking data, but does not pre-clear individual invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Digital webtoon publishing and multilingual chapter-unlocking revenues qualify for the 0% VAGST rate as exported services under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2018 where: (i) the recipient is non-resident and physically outside Samoa at the time of supply (including purchases via Apple IAP and Google Play Billing by overseas readers); (ii) the services are not enjoyed in Samoa and do not relate to land or goods in Samoa; (iii) the IC retains Merchant-of-Record agreements, platform settlement reports, and payout advices evidencing offshore consumption; and (iv) the IC, if VAGST-registered, substantiates input credits only for expenses attributable to the export activity. Because the IC operates as a Tax_Exempt_Zone entity, the exemption is typically enjoyed outside the net-invoicing mechanism, with refund claims arising only in the voluntary-registration scenario.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration — not applicable to electronically delivered services; substituted by platform settlement reports showing per-country gross sales
Bill of Lading — not applicable to digital delivery; substituted by Apple IAP / Google Play Merchant-of-Record payout and remittance statements
Merchant of Record agreements between WS_IC, Apple Inc. (iTunes Store), and Google LLC (Play Store)
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) from the IC's licensed bank in Samoa, or equivalent SWIFT/ACH payout advices from the platforms to the IC's bank account
End-user licensing and multilingual chapter-unlocking logs demonstrating delivery solely to non-resident customers outside Samoa
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may audit any 0% export zero-rating claim under the Tax Administration Act 2015, issuing a default assessment that claws back up to 3 years of uncharged VAGST at 15% (extended to 8 years for evasion and without time limit for fraud), plus a shortfall penalty of up to 150% of the tax avoided, 2% monthly interest, and late-payment penalties. Criminal prosecution for intentional evasion under Section 85 of the Tax Administration Act 2015 carries a fine of up to WS$1,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 7 years per count. Additionally, the Central Bank of Samoa may impose exchange-control sanctions on failure to repatriate export proceeds within the 180-day deadline, and the IC faces deregistration and loss of its tax-exemption certificate under the International Companies Act 1987 for fraudulent or falsely maintained export documentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984), acting in conjunction with the Samoan Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and the Ministry of Revenue. The Central Bank administers the Exchange Control Regulation 1974, as amended, and is the sole licensing and supervisory authority for all bank and non-bank clearing channels.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tālā (WST) is convertible for current-account international transactions, including software and digital content purchases, royalty remittances, webtoon license payments, and profit remittances from bona fide invested capital. Capital-account transfers, non-resident intercompany loans, intra-family trust injections, and offshore treasury placements remain subject to Central Bank prior authorization. For an International Company (WS_IC) deriving digital webtoon licensing revenue from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, the ordinary remittance of platform royalties is treated as a current-account service fee once evidenced by the platform settlement statement and license agreement. However, any capital transaction structured as a subscription to equity, an interest-free shareholder loan, or a hybrid convertible note will trigger exchange-control review with documentary proof of economic substance in Samoa.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoa maintains a repatriation-based export proceeds rule rather than a blanket mandatory percentage for digital exports. All export receipts, including online webtoon syndication income and advertising revenue, must be repatriated to a licensed Samoan bank account within 90 days of receipt by the offshore collection agent or payment gateway. There is no fixed statutory surrender ratio for digital IP exports; the Central Bank may apply a temporary surrender directive of up to 25% of realised foreign currency proceeds during a balance-of-payments emergency. At all events, the exporter must retain, for a minimum of five years, a documented trail showing net proceeds after deduction of Apple and Google commission fees, currency conversion costs, and downstream artist royalties. Failure to repatriate on time or launching a false online submission will be treated as a breach of the Exchange Control Regulation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of an International Company (Form IC-AR) and payment of the annual license fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 28 calendar days after the anniversary date of incorporation each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late fee equal to 10% of the annual fee is imposed after the 28-day window; continued non-payment for 90 days exposes the company to administrative strike-off by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Confirmation of registered office and registered agent (submitted as part of the annual return renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the same anniversary date of incorporation used for the annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered office and registered agent in Samoa is a continuing statutory default and may result in the Registrar initiating strike-off proceedings after notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) confirmation statement, including updates for any shareholding transfers during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies under Samoa’s Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism framework
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the annual return; in addition, any change in beneficial ownership or shareholding transfers must be reported within 14 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance attracts monetary penalties under the AML/CFT regulations and potential criminal liability for directors; persistent failure may also lead to administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit applies to a Samoa International Company unless the company is licensed under an international financial services regime (e.g., international banking, insurance, or trust licensing), or the Registrar or the company's articles of association require an independent auditor
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or other generally accepted accounting standards acceptable to the Samoa Registrar; accounting records must reflect financial position and transactions with reasonable accuracy

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every International Company must maintain an up-to-date beneficial ownership register and submit an annual confirmation with the annual return. For any shareholding transfer, the register of members must be updated and a UBO confirmation reflecting the new ownership must be lodged with the Registrar within 14 days; failure to disclose ultimate beneficial owners or a change in ownership may invalidate the annual confirmation and expose directors to penalties.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable due to audit waiver; if independently prepared under IFRS, estimated certified audit fee USD 2,500 - USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% for resident companies under the Income Tax Act 2017; 0% effective rate for International Companies (International Companies Act 1987, s.198) on all income derived outside Samoa, provided the IC does not carry on business in Samoa and derives no Samoan-source income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding taxes for International Companies. The only recurring fiscal charge is the annual government filing fee payable to the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), which is a regulatory levy rather than a tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (International Companies Act 1987, Part XI) submitted electronically through the SIFA Companies Online Registry (International Companies e-Register).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due within 60 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation. No automatic extension exists; a late filing may be accepted only at the Registrar's discretion and attracts escalating late fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1A - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal corporate name and the unique IC registration number as recorded in the Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as registered; any name change requires prior Registrar approval and a separate amendment form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2A - Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical Samoa street address and the name of the SIFA-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical Samoa address is mandatory; a post-office box alone is rejected. The agent must be a licensed international company service provider.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of principal objects and factual description of the webtoon syndication and digital comic publishing activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Certify that all content licensing, subscription unlocking (Apple IAP / Google Play Billing), and syndication operations are performed outside Samoa and that no Samoa-resident customers are served.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, physical addresses, and residential status of all directors and the secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are expressly permitted; the return must declare whether any director is ordinarily resident in Samoa.I omitted a space here - no, that's fine. If any director is Samoan-resident, the exemption may be jeopardized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital and the identity of each shareholder.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 100% non-resident shareholding is permitted; no minimum capital is required. Declare the Taiwanese beneficial owners when requested.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sworn attestation that the IC did not carry on business in Samoa, derived no Samoan-source income, and maintained required records at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration is pivotal; a false certification is a criminal offense and ground for deregistration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: An escalating monthly late fee applies for each overdue month, continued non-filing triggers a Registrar strike-off notice and automatic dissolution without court order, and restoration requires a court application plus reinstatement fees.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for International Companies under the statutory ICA exemption; the general Samoan dividend withholding tax rate for resident companies paying non-residents is 15%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: IC distributions are exempt at source, so no withholding clearance is required for ordinary repatriation. For any Samoan-source payments attracting WHT, the beneficial owner must obtain a Samoa tax residence certificate (TRC) from the Ministry of Revenue, and the payer must retain the TRC together with a beneficial-ownership declaration before applying the reduced treaty rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 15% on interest and royalties paid by Samoan residents; IC payers are exempt. Under the Samoa-New Zealand and Samoa-Australia double tax agreements, treaty relief may reduce rates to 0-10% depending on the instrument type and satisfaction of the beneficial-ownership test.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Local File or Master File obligation for International Companies because they are outside the Samoan income tax base; resident companies must prepare contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation when related-party transactions exceed WST 1,000,000 per tax year under the Income Tax Act 2017.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa is a member of the OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework on BEPS. An IC is non-resident for Samoan tax purposes and must demonstrate that management, content licensing decisions, and commercial operations occur in the beneficial owner's Taiwan establishment. A shell IC without substance in any jurisdiction attracts BEPS minimum-standard, anti-money-laundering (AML/CFT Act 2019), and cross-border information-exchange scrutiny.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling webtoon subscriptions, processing Samoan-currency payments, or contracting with Samoa residents within Samoa while purporting to be a tax-exempt International Company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Forfeiture of the ICA tax exemption, assessment as a resident company at 27%, penalties up to 100% of tax avoided, and deregistration under the International Companies Act 1987.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for restitution of tax and penalties; the corporate veil is pierced for wilful misconduct, exposing directors to personal monetary judgments and disqualification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing Taiwan webtoon royalty income through the Samoan IC solely to strip profits from high-tax jurisdictions without operational substance or commercial rationale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: General anti-avoidance reassessment, denial of deductions, penalties of 100% of avoided tax, voidance of treaty benefits under the principal-purpose test, and potential nullification of the IC's exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Shadow-director and promoter liability attaches: civil restitution, financial penalties, travel bans, and disgorgement of professional fees for architects of the sham structure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC's bank account or payment rails (Apple IAP / Google Play Billing) to launder proceeds of piracy, fraud, ransomware, or third-party criminal enterprise.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment up to 14 years and/or fines up to WST 2,000,000 under the AML/CFT Act 2019, asset freezing and forfeiture, and compulsory strike-off of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign, authorize, or facilitate such transactions incur personal criminal prosecution, travel bans, asset-freezing orders, and lifetime disqualification from managing any Samoan company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying that the IC carried on no Samoan business and derived no Samoan-source income when subscriptions were in fact earned from Samoan residents or from servers located in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Summary criminal conviction, monetary fines, retroactive termination of the tax exemption, and the Registrar's discretionary deregistration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Statutory personal liability for fines and restoration costs, director disqualification, and imprisonment for knowingly falsifying the compliance declaration.
